name: coinnavigator
description: CoinNavigator static site + net profit calculation engine

scripts.build:engine: tsup --config tsup.config.ts && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const a='assets/js/net-profit-engine.global.js'; const b='assets/js/net-profit-engine.js'; if (fs.existsSync(a)) { fs.renameSync(a,b); }"
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:engine
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build:engine && node --check assets/js/net-profit-engine.js
